description: Synthetic shopper feedback for demo, triage, and response-flow testing. Each record includes a replayable relative-path storefront journey. These are not customer records.

feedback.message: Will this battery fit a Boosted Mini X, or is it only for the larger boards? I do not want to order the wrong pack.

steps.target: Find a replacement battery for an existing Boosted board
steps.expected: Homepage navigation and featured products are visible
Accessory products are listed

steps.action: Search for a standard range battery
steps.expected: Search results include the standard range battery

steps.action: Inspect the product description and availability
steps.target: Mini X compatibility and variant availability
steps.expected: The shopper cannot confirm Mini X compatibility from the page

feedback.message: The remote is showing as sold out. Is there a compatible replacement, or can I join a back-in-stock list?

steps.expected: Homepage navigation is visible
Accessory products are listed
The remote appears in search results
The product is sold out and no clear alternative or notification option is visible

feedback.message: Does this kit include everything needed for the install, or do I need to buy a separate pulley and tool? A parts list would help.

steps.target: Find a pulley and belt upgrade
steps.expected: Homepage navigation is visible
Accessory products are listed

steps.action: Search for a pulley and belt kit
steps.expected: Search results include the pulley and belt upgrade kit

steps.action: Open the upgrade kit product page
steps.expected: The shopper cannot tell whether every required part and tool is included

steps.action: Open the Triple 8 Mips helmet product page

steps.target: Sizing guidance before adding to cart
steps.expected: The shopper still cannot choose a size with confidence

steps.target: Return window and return shipping responsibility
